text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold winners quickly, then bought some stocks back at higher prices; I should avoid letting the pleasure of realizing gains dictate my timing.","Buying back into a stock after selling it requires a fresh assessment of its outlook and risk, not just a reaction to its price movement.","Large losses in A and E show that doing nothing as a position falls can be costly; I should set clear review and risk limits rather than wait for a return to my purchase price."]}
